4. motionFidelity - 2: The motion of the stylized figures is jerky and lacks the smooth continuity of the original broadcast.
5. sceneFidelity - 2: The background stadium structure is almost entirely lost and inconsistent between frames.
6. stylizationStrength - 5: The transformation to a high-contrast, anime-NPR style is very strong and obvious.
